description: US interest rates and debt in one call: the Treasury par yield curve (1 month to 30 years) with week and month changes and the 2s10s, 3m10y and 5s30s spreads with inversion flags; New York Fed reference rates (SOFR and its 30/90/180-day averages, EFFR with the Fed target range, OBFR, TGCR, BGCR); total public debt with its 30-day change; and the average rate on marketable debt. Data: US Treasury, New York Fed. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
name: us_rates
